nodes.description: Constant token price in wei used to validate msg.value in mintRegenz.
Constant maximum total supply of tokens, bounds minting and used in modulo for starting index.
Constant reveal timestamp compared against block.timestamp in mintRegenz.
Constant maximum tokens mintable per transaction.
Constant number of tokens reserved for the owner in reserveRegenz.
Randomized offset for token metadata reveal, written in setStartingIndex and read in tokenURI.
Block recorded when sale completes or reveal time passes, used as seed in setStartingIndex.
Address authorized to withdraw contract ETH in claimETH.
Boolean toggle controlling whether minting is active, flipped in flipSaleState.
Mapping recording which token IDs each wallet minted.
Owner-only function that mints NUM_TO_RESERVE tokens to msg.sender using _safeMint.
Owner-only function that sets the base URI metadata prefix.
Owner-only function that toggles the saleIsActive flag.
Payable mint function validating price, supply and per-tx limits, then uses _safeMint in a loop and records purchases.
View function returning token IDs minted by a wallet.
Public function deriving startingIndex from blockhash of startingIndexBlock, with a late-call fallback using block.number.
Public function allowing claimEthAddress to withdraw the contract balance via transfer.
Overrides tokenURI applying startingIndex modulo to the token ID before delegating to super.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, ownership checks and ETH withdrawal authorization.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in mintRegenz.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on a recipient contract, an external callback enabling reentrancy before state finalization.
Native ETH transfer to claimEthAddress in claimETH, an external value transfer that can receive control.
Use of blockhash(block.number - 1) / blockhash(startingIndexBlock) as a pseudo-random source, giving miners/validators control over the reveal index.
User-supplied parameter of mintRegenz determining how many tokens are minted.
Parameter of setBaseURI holding the metadata prefix string.
Parameter of tokenURI identifying which token's URI is requested.
Local variable in reserveRegenz caching totalSupply() as the minting offset.

edges.reason: numberOfTokens is multiplied by PRICE and added to totalSupply in mintRegenz, so the untrusted count flows into arithmetic supply checks.
msg.sender is the recipient used by _safeMint inside mintRegenz.
msg.sender receives the reserved tokens minted in reserveRegenz.
claimETH authorizes the caller against claimEthAddress, making msg.sender the access-control subject of the withdrawal.
block.timestamp is compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in mintRegenz, letting miners influence when startingIndexBlock is set.
mintRegenz loops over _safeMint, which calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract before the purchase record is finalized.
reserveRegenz mints via _safeMint, triggering an external onERC721Received callback.
claimETH sends the entire balance with transfer, an external call that transfers control to claimEthAddress.
mintRegenz reads saleIsActive to require that the sale is running.
mintRegenz writes startingIndexBlock when supply is exhausted or reveal time has passed.
mintRegenz writes the minted token IDs and wallet into the regenzBought mapping.
mintRegenz compares totalSupply plus numberOfTokens against TOTAL_SUPPLY, an arithmetic supply constraint.
mintRegenz computes PRICE.mul(numberOfTokens) to validate msg.value, an arithmetic price computation.
mintRegenz reads MAX_PER_TX to enforce the per-transaction mint cap.
setStartingIndex writes the computed reveal offset into startingIndex.
setStartingIndex requires and reads startingIndexBlock as the blockhash seed.
setStartingIndex derives startingIndex from blockhash values, a miner-influenceable randomness source.
setStartingIndex applies modulo TOTAL_SUPPLY when computing startingIndex.
tokenURI reads startingIndex to compute the modded token ID.
tokenURI computes (tokenId + startingIndex) % TOTAL_SUPPLY.
The tokenId parameter flows into the index arithmetic performed in tokenURI.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
flipSaleState is onlyOwner, so msg.sender must match the stored owner for the state flip to occur.
The baseURI parameter is stored as the contract base URI in setBaseURI.
The supply local caches totalSupply and is added to the loop index to derive minted token IDs.

normalization_plan.reason: The numberOfTokens parameter has no meaning outside mintRegenz, where it feeds the supply and price checks and the mint loop.
The baseURI parameter is only used to call _setBaseURI within setBaseURI.
The tokenId parameter is only consumed inside tokenURI's modulo arithmetic and delegation to super.tokenURI.
The supply local is a temporary cache of totalSupply() used solely inside reserveRegenz.
